conventions.convention: The positive-definite orientation uses F_A^- = 0, hence self-dual curvature, together with c₂(P)[X] = −1. The gauge-fixed operator is d_A* ⊕ d_A^-.
Intersection lattices use integral second homology modulo torsion. The standard target lattice has the positive dot product.
The boundary lattice uses relative Poincaré–Lefschetz duals and the relative orientation class; rational-homology-sphere boundary ensures rational nondegeneracy, not unimodularity.
The regular five-dimensional moduli problem is the unbased H³/H⁴ quotient. The based quotient adds an SO(3) framing fiber.
Reducible projective links initially carry independently undetermined orientation signs. The perturbation preserves prepared reducible neighborhoods and vanishes on the small-instanton end.

The slice-cover gluing is X = W ∪_M (−B_D). Boundary normal generation is an additional hypothesis for the particular disk; the nonsliceness corollary requires it for every possible smooth slice disk.
The E8 Gram matrix has diagonal 2 and off-diagonal −1 on 12, 23, 34, 45, 56, 67 and 38. The displayed diagram uses exactly those edges.
Full AC is explicit throughout the analytic and gluing theorem chain. Freedman's TOP realization is an explicitly imported external input, not a locally reconstructed realization proof.

load_bearing.statement: Under full AC, for the specified closed simply connected positive-definite smooth four-manifold and charge-minus-one SU(2) bundle, the compatible perturbation and cut completion give a smooth compact oriented five-manifold with boundary X and one oriented CP² link for each actual reducible orbit; the number of links is at most b₂(X).

Assume full AC. Let X be a closed connected smooth simply connected oriented four-manifold. If its integral intersection form is positive definite, then there is an integral basis of H₂(X; Z)/Tor in which the form is the identity matrix.

Under full AC, an energy-bounded sequence of smooth self-dual SU(2) connections on a fixed bundle over a closed oriented Riemannian four-manifold has a subsequence converging modulo bundle comparisons off finitely many points to a smoothly removable self-dual limit, with positive integer bubble charges and k = k∞ + Σm_p.
For the stated real H¹-to-L² operator d_A* ⊕ d_A^-, with k = −⟨c₂(P),[X]⟩, the index is 8k − 3(1 − b₁(X) + b₋(X)); in the simply connected positive-definite charge-minus-one case it is five.

Under its full-AC, smooth slice-disk, rational-sphere boundary, simply connected positive-definite filling and boundary-normal-generation hypotheses, X = W ∪_M (−B_D) is closed smooth simply connected and positive definite, and inclusion gives an isometric full-rank lattice embedding with b₂(X) = b₂(W).

The specified rank-eight E8 form is positive definite, has determinant 1, and takes even values on every vector. It has no norm-one vector and admits no isometric full-rank embedding into the standard lattice Z⁸.

Assume full AC. There exists a closed connected simply connected oriented topological four-manifold whose integral intersection form is isometric to the positive-definite even unimodular E8 lattice; no smooth structure on the whole manifold is asserted.
Let n ≥ 1 and let L be a rank-n free abelian group with an integral symmetric form of Gram determinant ±1. Every isometric homomorphism L → Zⁿ with its standard dot product is surjective.

seams_checked.note: The branched-cover prerequisite uses the positive meridian and preferred longitude with the exterior-homology convention. No stronger peripheral claim is used.
The gluing lemma faithfully uses the connected double exterior cover filled along the closed lift of the squared meridian. Rational-sphere boundary is an explicit hypothesis.
This is a contextual page prerequisite. No surgery formula or surgery-trace conclusion is invoked by the assigned item proofs.
Smooth sliceness is the genus-zero proper smooth surface case in the standard four-ball. The consumers assume full AC, which includes the supplier's countable-choice hypothesis.

Donaldson's proof uses only the ordinary-signature vanishing clause of the actual five-dimensional bordism supplier. It does not infer existence of a bordism or use an unrestricted signature-comparison claim.

The compactness proof uses the small-curvature Coulomb-gauge supplier for smooth local connection forms. Curved-metric self-dual regularity is supplied separately; no Khovanov detection theorem is invoked.
